items.question: Which K-Electric IBC area has the most listed feeders?
items.answer: The IBC - Orangi - I area has the most listed feeders, with a total of 41.
items.sql: SELECT ibc, listed_feeders AS n FROM mart_ke_ibc_equity ORDER BY listed_feeders DESC LIMIT 1
caveats: IBC figures describe published schedules among listed feeders; small areas have small n.
items.answer_ur: IBC - Orangi - I کے علاقے میں 41 فیڈرز کی فہرست موجود ہے۔

items.question: How many listed K-Electric feeders are scheduled for six hours a day, and how many for twelve?
items.answer: The listed K-Electric feeders scheduled for six hours a day total 110, while those scheduled for twelve hours total 462.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN scheduled_hours_per_day = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feeders_6h, SUM(CASE WHEN scheduled_hours_per_day = 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feeders_12h, COUNT(*) AS n FROM mart_ke_feeder_hours
caveats: K-Electric scheduled hours are a published schedule, not measured outages.
Shares and averages are among listed feeders only.
items.answer_ur: فہرست شدہ K-Electric فیڈرز میں سے 110 فیڈرز روزانہ چھ گھنٹے کے شیڈول کے تحت ہیں جبکہ 462 فیڈرز بارہ گھنٹے کے شیڈول کے تحت ہیں۔

items.question: Show K-Electric's NEPRA-reported load-shedding hours per day for every fiscal year.
items.answer: The query returned 13 fiscal years of NEPRA-reported load-shedding hours for K-Electric, with values ranging from 1.1 to 3.4 hours per day. The reported figures for fiscal year 2021-22 are marked as having disagreeing values, while all other years show consistent single-source reporting.
items.sql: SELECT fiscal_year, reported_hours_per_day, values_disagree, 1 AS n FROM mart_nepra_load_shedding WHERE company = 'K-Electric' ORDER BY fiscal_year
caveats: These are NEPRA-reported figures, not Roshni measurements; a reported 0 means nil reported.
items.answer_ur: K-Electric کے NEPRA رپورٹ کردہ روزانہ لوڈ شیڈنگ کے اوقات مالی سال 2012-13 سے 2021-22 تک 2.4 سے لے کر 3.4 گھنٹوں کے درمیان ہیں۔

items.question: What is the most common purpose given for IESCO maintenance windows?
items.answer: The most common purpose listed for IESCO maintenance windows is Annual Maintenance, which appears 12,067 times.
items.sql: SELECT purpose, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fct_maintenance_window GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
caveats: Maintenance windows are announced plans, not measured outages.
items.answer_ur: IESCO کی دیکھ بھال کے کھڑکیوں کے لیے سب سے عام مقصد Annual Maintenance ہے جس کی تعداد 12,067 ہے۔

items.question: Which five K-Electric IBC areas have the highest share of feeders on the twelve-hour schedule?
items.answer: The five K-Electric IBC areas with the highest share of feeders on the twelve-hour schedule are IBC - Clifton, IBC - Uthal, IBC - Layari - II, IBC - Orangi - I, and IBC - Baldia.
items.sql: SELECT ibc, share_12h_pct, scheduled_feeders AS n FROM mart_ke_ibc_equity WHERE scheduled_feeders > 0 ORDER BY share_12h_pct DESC LIMIT 5
caveats: IBC figures describe published schedules among listed feeders; small areas have small n.
items.answer_ur: IBC - Clifton کی شیئر 100.0 ہے اور اس میں 11 فیڈرز شامل ہیں۔ IBC - Uthal کی شیئر بھی 100.0 ہے اور اس میں 9 فیڈرز ہیں۔ IBC - Layari - II کی شیئر 97.4 ہے اور اس میں 38 فیڈرز شامل ہیں۔ IBC - Orangi - I کی شیئر 95.1 ہے اور اس میں 41 فیڈرز ہیں۔ IBC - Baldia کی شیئر 94.4 ہے اور اس میں 36 فیڈرز شامل ہیں۔

items.question: What is the average scheduled hours per day for each K-Electric loss category?
items.answer: The scheduled hours per day for the High loss category average 11.2, for the Medium category average 6.5, and for the Very High category average 12.0.
items.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(scheduled_hours_per_day), 1) AS avg_scheduled_hours, COUNT(*) AS n FROM mart_ke_feeder_hours GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
caveats: K-Electric scheduled hours are a published schedule, not measured outages.
Shares and averages are among listed feeders only.
items.answer_ur: K-Electric کے اعلیٰ زمرے کی اوسط شیڈولڈ گھنٹے 11.2 ہیں، درمیانے زمرے کی 6.5 ہیں اور بہت اعلیٰ زمرے کی 12.0 ہیں۔

items.question: Which Karachi census subdivision has the highest literacy rate, and what is its share of twelve-hour feeders?
items.answer: The top result identifies SHAH FAISAL SUB-DIVISION with a literacy rate of 89.6 and a twelve-hour feeder share of 42.1.
items.sql: SELECT subdivision_name, literacy_pct, share_12h_pct FROM mart_ke_subdivision_equity ORDER BY literacy_pct DESC LIMIT 1
caveats: Census indicators are descriptive context (PBS Census 2023); no causal link is implied.
items.answer_ur: SHAH FAISAL SUB-DIVISION کی خواندگی کی شرح 89.6 ہے اور اس کا بارہ گھنٹے فیڈرز کا حصہ 42.1 ہے۔
